Title: Mordred chemical descriptors
Description: Computes Mordred molecular descriptors, covering constitutional counts, topological and connectivity indices, autocorrelations, charge and surface-area terms. Moriwaki and colleagues released it as an open alternative to PaDEL-Descriptor, at least twice as fast and able to handle large molecules that other packages reject. Ersilia calculates the two-dimensional descriptor set, drops the columns that are frequently undefined and fills the remaining gaps with an imputer, leaving 1,458 values. Results are deterministic, though many descriptors are strongly correlated.
Interpretation: 1458 two-dimensional Mordred descriptors with missing values imputed, spanning constitutional, topological and physicochemical properties.
